env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
stdout '^seen 3 steps 3$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/yieldeject/m

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"iter"
)

var steps int

func Tracked(n int) iter.Seq[int] {
	for i := range n {
		steps++
		yield i
	}
	steps += 1000
}

func main() {
	seen := 0
	for v := range Tracked(100) {
		_ = v
		seen++
		if seen == 3 {
			break
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("seen", seen, "steps", steps)
}
